articleTitle: Mask wearing detection method based on SSD-Mask algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the spread of COVID-19 all over the world, under the background of normalized epidemic prevention and control, proper wearing and using of masks can effectively filter virus pathogen particles. In order to reduce the infection rate of ordinary people and improve the efficiency of monitoring people wearing masks in public places, this paper improves a method of face mask wearing detection in natural scenes. On the basis of SSD algorithm, SSD-Mask introduces a channel attention mechanism to improve the ability of the model to express salient features. At the same time, the information of different feature levels is fully utilized, and the loss function is optimized. The final experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively achieve the goal of face recognition and mask detection.

articleTitle: Academic Records Verification Platform Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Recently, blockchain technology has received substantial attention from researchers and developers. Although some research explores the uses of the blockchain and practice it in the real world, blockchain has not yet been applied widely in the education area. The goal of this research is to present an academic records verification platform which is cost-effective and secure based on the blockchain. Previous research on the applications of the blockchain and the RSA algorithm lays a strong foundation for this study. The decentralized nature of the blockchain is utilized to testify the academic honesty of students, and RSA algorithm protects the privacy of individuals. Plus, the demands of different groups of people contribute to constructing a user-friendly platform. Next, the framework of the platform is presented, including the procedures of verification and query, and the traditional platform of student record verification and this platform are compared. Lastly, the conclusion analyzes the efficiency and explains the way how the platform is useful to people and a few limitations existing in the practice of the platform. This research studys established papers to analyze novel technology, the demands of people and the analysis of traditional platform for proposing a novel framework of the student record verification platform. The result shows that the platform is more cost-effective and convenient than conventional way of verification.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Network Capacity for LEO Satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In this paper, a Low Earth Orbit satellite (LEO) network capacity model is proposed to value the influence of routing strategy and the difference between the intra-plan ISL and the inter-plan ISL on throughput capacity. The Analysis shows that for LEO constellation, Central routing algorithm presents superior traffic distribution ability in LEO network than distributed routing strategy. The performance of choosing a co-orbiting satellite is better than choosing a different-orbiting satellite when there are mutliple equal cost transmission paths. Simulation results prove that central routing algorithm combined with priority selection of satellites in the same orbital plane in LEO satellite network could reduce data packet loss rate, achieve optimization on network capacity.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Lunar Impact Crater Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Impact craters are the most prominent topographic feature on the lunar surface, which will play a very important role in the construction of lunar bases and lunar surface activities in the future. Due to the large number of meteorite craters, different diameters and shapes, and the superposition of their morphologies, the artificial identification of meteorite craters is not only inaccurate but also inefficient. This paper first summarizes the significance of lunar impact crater research, then analyzes and summarizes the method of crater extraction, research status and the resulting data set, and finally summarizes the difficult problems and directions of future lunar impact crater identification research. Current crater-detection approaches fall into three categories, such as artificial detection, traditional automatic recognition and machine learning dtetection. With the development of computer, the convolutional neural network has become the trend of crater identification. Developing new images or data and training different network models is the key content of future research.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection of Table Tennis Based on Deep Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the visual system of table tennis robot and the fast movement speed of table tennis, this paper focuses on balancing the speed and accuracy of small object detection based on deep learning network. We propose a deep learning network which is more suitable for small target detection, improving the detection accuracy while ensuring the detection speed to meet the real-time match. Firstly, we constructed a dataset including 20000 table tennis images. Then, we use convolutional neural network with residual connection to extract image features and construct the feature pyramid to increase the performance of network for small object detection. The feature map with rich semantic information in the upper layer is fused with the layer with rich object position information in the lower layer. We propose a new data augmentation method. During training the table tennis target on each picture is copied three times, which greatly increases the ability of network learning the feature of small target. Experimental results show that our model proposed in this paper can improve the accuracy and speed of table tennis detection, and bring great significance to the design and application of table tennis visual system.

articleTitle: Automatic Sales Forecasting System Based On LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Sales forecasting is especially valuable for retail business owners. Based on sales predictions, shops can greatly reduce actual or opportunity costs and generate more revenue. In this paper, we proposed a long short term memory(LSTM) based deep learning method to predict future sales in 28 days according to previous sales records. Our model is trained and evaluated on the Walmart sales dataset which contains sales records for 30491 goods over a course of 1913 days among supplementary information. We employed efficient feature engineering techniques and in experiments, our model outperforms other methods like SVM and Linear Regression, reaching an RMSSE of 0.834.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Power Grid Data Asset Management Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Although the continuous construction of smart grid and power Internet of Things has brought massive data to grid enterprises, the cost of data storage, operation and maintenance is gradually increasing, on the contrary, the value of data has not been effectively mined and utilized, the main reason is that the current data asset management of State Grid Corporation of China is still an infancy stage, and still faces the problems of data aggregation quality, safety and compliance control, shared application scope, and management mechanism efficiency and so on. In order to solve the above problems, Big Data Center of State Grid Corporation of China takes advantage of the blockchain with distributed consensus autonomy and data storage, non-tampering and traceability, and business intelligence contract script, explores the application of blockchain in power grid data asset management, and then, tries to construct the architecture of power grid data asset management based on blockchain, which is to promote security compliance and open sharing of power grid data operation, and realize the efficient management and operation of power grid data assets.

articleTitle: Research on Information Encryption and Hiding Technology of 3D Point Cloud Data Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In view of the weakness of the existing STL data model's copyright information embedding technology, an information hiding algorithm based on DCT algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the STL data model is processed by PCA to eliminate the influence of model space transformation. Secondly, the embedded key information is selected and encrypted by Arnold transform. Finally, by using DCT transform, the STL model is generated by embedding copyright message into robust space, and the model error is evaluated. Simulation results show that, compared with the spatial domain protection methods such as histogram shift, the algorithm has stronger anti-attack ability under the normal display of the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Blockchain-Based Privacy Protection for Internet Financial Product Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Internet financial product recommendation systems can solve the problem of personalized differences among users in choosing financial products, but accurate recommendation needs to collect a large amount of privacy information of users. Nowadays, the situation of privacy information leakage is very serious, and the situation of reselling information, spam messages and harassing calls on the Internet is becoming increasingly serious. On the basis of discussing the privacy protection strategy of recommendation system, this paper analyzes the advantages of blockchain in protecting users’ privacy, and designs a new operating mechanism of financial product recommendation system based on blockchain technology. Blockchain encryption mechanism, smart contract and other technologies can ensure financial users to control their own information in the process of submitting, sharing and obtaining recommendation results, and ensure users’ privacy and fairness of recommendation results.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Sensor Data Management System Based on Distributed Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Sensor data is one of the basic source of big data in the Internet of Things(IoT). It is the data that is sensed, measured, and transmitted by sensors with real-time and dynamic characteristics. With the development of the IoT and big data technologies, new industries such as smart transportation, smart cities, and smart agriculture have gradually formed, resulting in an increasing demand for large-scale data analysis and calculations. However, the storage architecture based on relational databases has been unable to meet the current needs in terms of data storage and data read and write speed. Therefore, this paper mainly studies the sensor data management system based on distributed storage, builds a Hadoop cluster, proposes a storage structure that combines the relational database MySQL with the distributed database HBase, designs a data migration module to satisfy real-time sensor data monitoring and massive data storage requirements. In order to meet the needs of enterprises in actual production, SSM framework technology is used to build a sensor data management platform, covering the functions of system management, sensor data management, data exception management, sensor data real-time monitoring, sensor node status monitoring, data statistical analysis, etc. The platform has good security and reliability, and can effectively improve the management efficiency of the enterprise. Finally, the experiment provides that the system has obvious advantages in data upload and query ability compared with the traditional storage architecture. It provides a good data environment for data analysis and data mining in the future.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia Computer Technology in Live-stream Shopping —— From the Perspective of User’s Purchasing Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the transformation of Internet technology from traditional PC terminal to personal mobile terminal, Chinese e-commerce industry has achieved unprecedented development. Live streaming technology not only provide more abundant marketing mode for merchants, but also creates a more convenient environment for its audiences. Exploring the factors that affect users' purchasing behavior in live broadcast scene can provide practical guidance for the next optimization of live-stream technology. Meanwhile, it is also important for the further development of e-commerce industry in multimedia environment. From the perspective of users, this paper explored and analyzed the application of computer multimedia technology in e-commerce, and draws the following conclusions: users' age is negatively related to their willing to purchase; while, users' network application skill, live-stream platforms' reputation, ease of use and price discount of the recommended products are all positively related to users' purchasing intention. To sum up, we need to build a more convenient live-stream environment with the help of the multimedia computer technology, and then further reduce the "technical threshold" of the elderly users.

articleTitle: The Practical Application of QAR Data in Civil Aviation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Quick Access Recorder of civil aviation aircraft, referred to as "QAR", is used for real-time recording of hundreds of flight parameters such as flight altitude, speed, angle, acceleration, stick, fuel consumption, etc., these flight parameters for short "QAR data". QAR data is translated into engineering data, diagrams and animations for easy viewing through the ground decoding system. With the rapid development of China’s civil aviation, QAR has developed into WQAR, realizing wireless transmission. QAR data is widely used in civil aviation, especially in safety management. Using QAR data to assist in the investigation of civil aviation unsafe incidents can not only improve the efficiency of the investigation, but also objectively restore the incident.

articleTitle: Hot Topics and Frontier Analysis of International Accounting Research Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As a general business language, accounting plays an important role in international economic exchanges and economic development. This paper uses CiteSpace software developed by Professor Chen Chaomei to analyse the hot topics and frontiers of international accounting research in recent ten years. The results show that, earnings management, information disclosure and executive compensation are the hot topics in the area of accounting research. After the emergence of the word literature analysis, it is found that, the frontier of accounting research has not changed significantly in the past ten years, and some classic topics in accounting academic circles are still the research hotspots. The difference is that modern network technology, communication technology and other technical means are used to analysed the original topic more deeply.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection via Deep Learning Method Using Data Balance Tools
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Previous studies have shown the effectiveness of deep learning algorithms in improving the detection of credit card fraud, which has become a major issue for financial institutions. This paper discusses how two deep learning methods, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and auto-encoder, perform in the fraud detection task using two different datasets. This research utilizes a brand-new dataset with all raw input variables and a Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB) transaction dataset, which has been preprocessed with PCA technology. Since imbalanced datasets can affect the training quality, we further preprocess the datasets using random under-sampling and the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Techniques (SMOTE) to balance the datasets. Through the experimental results, we find that the networks perform well for the ULB dataset with 93% accuracy in prediction, but perform poorly for the independent input dataset, and the performance can be improved when increasing the complexity of the network. We also notice that the under-sampling method helps improve prediction accuracy better than the oversampling method. The results indicate that more complicated networks are required to detect fraud when the criterion for fraud is stricter, while balancing the dataset before training will improve the results.

articleTitle: Research on Short Text Classification Based on Word2Vec Microblog
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As a social product in the Internet age, Microblog has the characteristics of concise language and large amount of information. Mining the information in the Microblog text is of great significance to topic detection and personalized recommendation systems. Compared with traditional text classification, short text has the problems of dimensionality and sparseness. The article first uses the neural network's Word2Vec to get the word vector, and then introduces the category attribute into the word weight. The short text vector is obtained by the weighted summation method, and finally the text data is trained using the SVM classifier. Through the comparison of experimental results, the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on the fusion method of 2D and 3D UNet in pulmonary nodules segmentation task
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In segmentation task of pulmonary nodules CT image, the U-shaped convolution neural network (UNet) has made great progress in segmentation accuracy and stability. However, for the three-dimensional (3D) connection characteristics of medical sequence slices, 3D segmentation networks often can't give full play to their potential and advantages constrained by such factors as the number of marked samples and the computing capacity of equipment. For this reason, this paper focuses on the fusion methods of 2D and 3D UNet in medical image segmentation task: the first is to give full play to the advantages of 2D and 3D networks respectively, and propose a segmentation network model based on two-level hierarchical structure; the second is to make full use of the context information between the image slices and propose a 2.5D segmentation network model. The experiments based on LIDC-IDRI dataset show that the above two methods achieve a good balance in terms of computational performance, segmentation accuracy and model stability.

articleTitle: Power mechanism and strategy of digital transformation in power grid industry -Take State Grid Jibei Electric Power Company Limited as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the promotion of Digital China and digital economy, China’s power grid enterprises and other traditional enterprises have carried out digital transformation. Taking the State Grid Jibei Electric Power Company Limited as an example, this paper analyzes the internal and external dynamic factors of the digital transformation of power grid enterprises, and analyzes the dynamic mechanism of digital transformation by using the system dynamics theory. In the process of digital transformation, the external power has the role of promoting and guiding the internal power. The internal power has the reaction and the concrete function to the external power. Finally, the paper puts forward some suggestions for the development of digital transformation, which include establishing inclusive culture, cultivating digital business technical personnel, getting through power grid business data, docking with external data of enterprises, providing data asset support for digital transformation, establishing digital ecology of power grid and social service business of the company, improving the application ability of digital tools, mining data value, and building modular power data commodity, improving the digital service capability of the company.

articleTitle: Efficient and Privacy-Preserving of COVID-19 Contact Tracing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The world has seen many pandemics in the past. COVID-19, SARS, H1N1, and Ebola are some of them. When these diseases break out, they spread very quickly, and tracing the source becomes a challenge to control the disease. In this paper, under the premise of not divulging the private information for infected persons and their potential contacts, we have proposed a privacy-preserving contact tracking schemes of infectious persons. In these schemes, if a user is diagnosed with COVID-19, potential contacts with the virus can be traced, so that Healthy Authority(HA) can better control the spread of the virus. The process is private and does not disclose any unnecessary information. In addition, we evaluate our schemes and compare them with existing similar schemes. Our scheme achieving all security goals and having lower communication and computation costs.

articleTitle: Optimization and application of crossroad similarity matching based on the clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The collected crossroad data is clustered through an unsupervised machine learning algorithm to find the internal connections between different traffic intersections. This paper hopes that in the future traffic jams solving process, clustering algorithms can be used for reference to aggregate the similar traffic junction control experience into a same category, to guide relevant technical personnel to quickly find out the cause of the congestion problem in the urban traffic road network, thus formulating a reasonable and feasible traffic jam control plan based on the same category of traffic junction control experience.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of Human Resource Management Based on MYSQL database
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: MySQL is one of the well-known open source databases under Oracle. It is trusted by customers around the world due to its high performance, low cost, and good reliability. This study adopts the internal personnel file electronic program of the organization, quantifies the huge human resource data over the years, uses MYSQL database management, and analyzes the talent introduction and loss of Cunjin College in recent years through data extraction and visual analysis, and find out the reasons., Finally, from the perspective of strategic development, measures for talent team building are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Web 3D display based on STL model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to overcome the difficult of Web 3D display of STL model, a 3D display of STL model based on Three.js is proposed. Firstly, based on the HTML page framework, the settings of scene, camera and Tenderer are completed, and the 3D model display based on Three.js is realized. Then, the interactive browsing of 3D model is realized by moving the camera and creating animation, and the outer surface color of the model is controlled by using dat.GUI library. Finally, the browser support of WebGL is introduced. Finally, the user can browse STL model interactively on the Web without installing any plug-in.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of emission monitoring platform for heavy duty diesel vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Heavy duty diesel vehicle emissions have become one of the main sources of air pollution in large and medium-sized cities. In order to reduce the heavy-duty diesel vehicle emissions, this paper designs a heavy-duty diesel vehicle emission remote monitoring platform. With the help of big data technology and Internet technology, the real-time monitoring of heavy-duty diesel vehicle emissions and faults under actual road conditions is carried out. The innovative proposal of the platform is to store data in the form of distributed files, make use of big data computing engine, and give full play to the computing power of the server. It realizes the storage and mining of massive emission data, and solves the problems of difficult storage, retrieval and analysis of vehicle road measured big data. The platform realizes real-time remote monitoring and diagnosis of NOx and particulate matter of heavy-duty diesel vehicles, and carries out correlation analysis of vehicle operation parameters, emission / fuel consumption with the help of monitoring information of OBD, which provides strong support for enterprise product development and government emission supervision.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Analysis and Fault Diagnosis of Electric Power Control Based on Warning Signal Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rising requirements for power grid operation and management, power control technology needs to be more intelligent to ensure that grid faults can be responded in time. Based on this, this paper puts forward the intelligent analysis of power control, which can extract valuable information from the perspective of warning signal mining, and make scientific diagnosis of faults through artificial intelligence calculations to obtain reliable power control decisions.

articleTitle: Research on Scientific Research Performance Evaluation Based on the Innovation Ability by Computer Science
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Scientific and technological innovation is an important force in the construction of innovative national strategy. The promotion of scientific research and innovation ability is related to the development of economy and society. Scientific research performance evaluation is based on the improvement of scientific research, as well as the development of scientific research activities. By computer science, we can assure its proficiency. It aims to actively promote the initiative of scientific research, and improve the efficiency of scientific research management. Scientific research and innovation ability are different to an extent. Traditionally, scientific research evaluation is based on the level of project leaders, personnel composition, the number of projects obtained or the level of achievements, which are not that appropriate nor scientific. Therefore, based on the qualitative and quantitative analysis of the scientific research by computer, this paper focuses on exploring scientific research performance evaluation by computer science. With the premise of clarifying the scientific research innovation ability, innovation composition, innovation goal and innovation significance, this paper will explore the strategies and methods by computer, to enhance scientific research innovation ability of colleges and universities, so as to give a reference to colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Machine-based automotive intrusion detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Aiming at the information security problems of intelligent networked vehicles, especially the communication security and application security issues, this paper studies how to identify abnormal behaviors related to security from the massive network data, application data and vehicle bus data generated in real time by machine learning technology, and form the intrusion detection system technology based on neural network. In this paper, the characteristics of the existing data sets are deeply studied, and a variety of new features are proposed based on the domain knowledge of various network attacks in the Internet of vehicles environment, and the standard data set for the network security detection field of the Internet of vehicles environment is constructed. The framework of intrusion detection system based on neural network vehicle bus is studied. Research on machine learning model and model fusion technology suitable for abnormal detection of bus data, Ethernet data and operating system log data, fill in the domestic technical gap, provide strong support for the implementation of active defense, and improve the information security defense level of intelligent networked vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on agricultural product traceability system based on block chain technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This system is mainly designed and developed based on the technology of block chain of agricultural products traceability system, and on the traceability system architecture, the development platform of the fabric, design of each functional module is studied, finally combining block chain technology and integrated supply chain management model, to provide a favorable block chain technology implementation environment, the whole process of construction of agricultural products from production to sales tracking and traceability system, realize the entire quality control of agricultural products, healthy competition between businesses and consumers rational consumption of science.

articleTitle: Computer Technology Promotes Enterprise Digital Transformation—— Taking Z Company FSSC Construction as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: COVID-19 has amplified the urgency of digital transformation of enterprises. The development and application of computer technologies such as 5G, blockchain, and big data provide favorable conditions for the digital transformation of enterprises. Financial digital transformation is at the forefront of the digital age. So, this article takes the construction of Z company's Financial Shared Service Center (FSSC) as an example, through the analysis of the construction process, function positioning, application effects and problems in the construction of the Z company's FSSC, it is concluded that enterprises should pay attention to several key points in the construction of the FSSC, the first step of the company in digital transformation. Such as accurate positioning, laying a good foundation for standardization, staff enhancement, scientific management and control process design, and top leaders' attention. And finally combined with the development of computer technology to make a prospect for the application of FSSC in public institutions and governments across the country.

articleTitle: Adjacent vertex distinguishing incidence coloring of semi-strong product of paths
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Adjacent vertex distinguishing incidence coloring of graph G is an incidence coloring that satisfies that adjacent vertices have different color sets, and the minimum color number is called the adjacent vertex distinguishing incidence coloring number of graph G, which is denoted as χ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ai</sub> (G). In this paper, we study the adjacent vertex distinguishing incidence coloring of semi-strong products and strong products of paths of different orders, and obtain the exact values of the corresponding coloring numbers.

Author Keywords: Adjacent vertex distinguishing incidence coloring number

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Video Feedback System in College Basketball Shooting Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Objective: To test the effect of the artificial intelligence video feedback system in the basketball shooting teaching in Colleges and universities. Methods: 24 male basketball players from XX University were randomly divided into experimental group (n=12) and control group (n=12). The experimental group and the control group were given shooting learning for 8 weeks. During each teaching period, the experimental group was intervened with 10-minute video feedback system, while the control group was not intervened. Results: After the experiment, the shooting percentage and the performance of action skill evaluation of the experimental group were significantly higher than those before the experiment (p=0. 032<0.05). After the experiment, the control group in the fixed-point shot and jump shot shooting percentage and action skill evaluation results were higher than before the experiment (p=0.158>0.05). After the experiment, the experimental group in the fixed-point shot and jump shot shooting percentage and action skill evaluation results were significantly higher than the control group (p=0. 026<0.05). Conclusion: The application of artificial intelligence video feedback system in college basketball shooting teaching is helpful to: Students can get the action points of shooting technique more richly and intuitively; Help students quickly establish the technical action model and spatial thinking concept of shooting; The correction and consolidation of shooting techniques are more personalized and timely.

articleTitle: Discussion on SOC system construction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: By introducing the transformation of NOC to SOC, this paper analyzes the main contents of SOC system, and discusses the five general thoughts of changing operation thinking, determining construction objectives, setting up a team and formulating rules and procedures, and building a technology platform for the construction of SOC system.

articleTitle: Research on Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on Network Dynamics Evolution Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the advent of the intelligent era and the popularity of science and technology in people's lives, a variety of intelligent technologies play a more and more important role in people's lives. Among them, image segmentation as a necessary step in the process of photo processing, it is very necessary to study it. Based on the traditional image segmentation technology usually has some defects, the integration of network dynamics into the research of image segmentation technology is the general trend of development in this field.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy of Energy Local Network Based on Energy Storage Virtual Queue
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to improve the level of renewable energy consumption and reduce the simulation error caused by the model prediction, aiming at the problem of synergetic utilization of energy local network including electric vehicles and high penetration photovoltaic grid connected, a virtual energy storage queue based on Lyapunov optimization technology is proposed. Taking electric vehicle load as an example, the time coupling constraint in energy management problem is transformed into queue stability problem for flexible load which does not need to be satisfied immediately. Through the formation of Lyapunov drift penalty function, the energy management problem is simplified. And the control decision is determined according to the real-time operation status, so as to achieve the goal of reducing the operation cost. Simulation and experimental results show that the method improves the utilization of renewable energy, and verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm in reducing operating costs.

articleTitle: Queue Mining and Prediction Based on Context-Fusion Scenario
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: To solve the problems of business process mining and process execution time prediction based on event logs more accurately and efficiently, this paper proposes a queue mining and prediction method that integrates contextual scenarios. Firstly a scenario model that integrates contextual information is established. Then typical queues is mined from event log data based on the scenario model, and then maps tasks to the corresponding scenarios of the specific queues to predict the completion time. Finally, according to the real data set of a financial institution’s actual process executing, the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Proper additive coloring of Special Graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: An additive coloring of a graph G is an assignment of positive integers {1,2, ⋯, k} to the vertices of G such that for every two adjacent vertices the sums of numbers assigned to their neighbors are different. articleTitle: Understanding the Opinion Leader Effect in Online Livestreaming Technology Application Platforms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the increasing development of computer network and device technologies, live streaming becomes a new media format for various industries, such as electronic commerce. The opinion leader can record and broadcast their product recommendation in online live streaming. In this paper, we explore the effect of opinion leader features on audiences from the perspective of flow theory, in order to provide important implications for online livestreaming platforms aiming to optimize their operation mechanisms and recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: In-depth Informatization of Technology Management of Dateng Gorge Water Conservancy Project
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As a large-scale livelihood project, the Dateng Gorge water conservancy project needs to consider many factors such as safety, resettlement, environment, energy, and flood control, which involve all aspects of technical problems. Effective management of the technologies can improve the construction efficiency of the project. With the development of science and technology, informatization of technology management becomes an inevitable trend. Especially in the current information sharing era, only with multi-dimensional and in-depth informatization can the increasing needs for technology management be met. In the present study, a multi-dimensional technology management system was established for the Dateng Gorge water conservancy project, featuring full-cycle tracking, information sharing and interdepartmental collaboration. Innovative solutions based on the investment systems, BIM management, three-dimensional application, data certificate CA and mobile office were employed to realize informatized management of technologies in the water conservancy project.

articleTitle: Study of Profitability, Financial Risk and Safety responsibility of coal enterprises based on SPSS and Regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Regression analysis is a predictive modeling technique that studies the relationship between dependent variables and independent variables. It is usually used for predictive analysis, time series models, and to discover the causal relationship between variables. This paper uses professional statistical software SPAA24.0 to process and analyze the causal relationship between the profitability of coal enterprises, financial risks and safety responsibility performance. Data analysis shows that the profitability of coal companies can promote the performance of corporate safety responsibilities, while financial risks can inhibit the performance of corporate safety responsibilities. To a certain extent, profitability can reduce the restraint of financial risks on the company's safety responsibility.

articleTitle: Japanese Education Reform and Talent Training Mode Construction Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for Japanese professionals in the market, colleges and universities need to strengthen education reform, build an effective talent training model, and train Japanese professionals with strong professional ability for the country. With the increasing number of Japanese majors and the relative shrinking of the employment market, it is urgent for us to adjust and improve the existing talent training strategies. Data mining is a process of extracting implicit, implicit but useful information and knowledge from a large number of incomplete, noisy, fuzzy and random data. Its main function is to find valuable information from massive data and transform the data into organized knowledge. Based on data mining, this paper analyzes the specific goals of cross-cultural communication in Japanese teaching, and puts forward some suggestions on the cultivation of cross-cultural communication ability and the construction of its training mode, so as to cultivate Japanese talents with foreign language quality and cultural quality and cross-cultural communication in teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Content Recommendation System of Army Equipment Information Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Aiming at the actual needs of content recommendation of the Army Equipment Information Network, combined with the characteristics of users and content on the website, this article analyzed that the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm has poor recommendation results due to cold start and data sparse. A new algorithm which combined content-based recommendation algorithm with traditional collaborative filtering algorithm was proposed to solve this problem. The authors researched and designed a suitable model for the content recommendation of the website, and proposed a proper recommendation algorithm. Finally, the content of the website and the users' behavior data were used as experimental content to verify the validity of the proposed model algorithm. The results showed that the proposed recommendation algorithm could maintain a certain accuracy and fraction of coverage when the K value was at an appropriate value. The method met the personalized needs of users when browsing the website news.

articleTitle: On Star Coloring of Mycielski's Graphs for Special Graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Let G be a simple graph with vertex set V (G) and edge set E (G). A vertex coloring of G is called a star coloring of G if any path of 4 order is bicolored. articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Solution of Upper Body Gravity Center of Exoskeleton Based on Maplesim
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The acquisition of the center of gravity of the upper body of the exoskeleton robot is critical in the balance control. In order to solve the problems of poor portability, low efficiency and precision of gravity center solution for exoskeleton, the multi- domain system-level modeling and simulation software Maplesim was used for parametric modeling of exoskeleton upper body and a real-time gravity center solution method with strong portability was proposed. The method can directly transplant to the exoskeleton with similar configuration, and the center of gravity can be calculated in real time by assigning the parameters, which is efficient and accurate.

articleTitle: Anti-air Missiles Synergic Battle Effectiveness Technique Study in Support of Information of Sky and Firmament
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Based on the battlefield environment support information of sky and firmament, this paper puts focus on the study of anti-air missiles synergic battle effectiveness technique evaluation. By the analyses of function, usage of soft technique can avoid imitation of former static and dynamic effect valuation system, and make the analyzing results approach a true circumstance more. So, it has certain instruction meaning to the effectiveness improvement of anti-air and anti-missile battle.

articleTitle: SLAM Global Positioning Algorithm Based on Laser and Vision Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Positioning technology is the basis for realizing fully autonomous navigation of mobile robots. Particle filtering is used as a non-parametric Bayesian filter to solve this problem. However, due to particle degradation, random sampling error, large amount of calculation, etc., particle filter positioning always has accuracy and efficiency problems. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the global initial positioning of the laser, this paper proposes a global positioning algorithm fusion laser and vision. The algorithm integrates particle filtering, laser beam model, and visual observation model to enable the robot to complete faster and more accurate global positioning with a small amount of prior and motion information. The experimental results on the MIT-STATA dataset show that compared with the particle filter algorithm, this method can improve the accuracy and efficiency of the robot's global positioning.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of The Relationship between Social Financing Scale and Regional Development based on Stata Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Stata is not only a statistical analysis software, but also has a strong program language function. The empirical research relationship is realized through the design of algorithms. This article uses time data such as the scale of social financing, regional GDP, total retail sales of consumer goods, and total fixed investment data in Henan Province from 2010 to 2019. Then using stata to analyze the relationship between social financing scale and regional development. This article mainly uses Stata to carry out a variety of algorithm design steps on these time series data, next to explore the relationship between variables. The result of the operation show that the scale of social financing has a positive effect on regional development. Finally, a scheme for optimizing this positive relationship is given with the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the calculation method of Apriori algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: When mining frequent itemsets, the traditional Apriori algorithm uses iterative calculation support level by layer. It needs to scan the database for many times and perform I/O operations frequently. Moreover, it is sensitive to the original data. When the data structure is complex, the number of data items is large, and the density of data elements is high, the problem of low efficiency of Apriori algorithm is obvious. In order to further improve the performance of Apriori algorithm, this paper analyzes the operation principle of the algorithm, and proposes MI_Apriori(Multiset intersection Apriori) algorithm. Based on the equivalent Boolean matrix of transaction records, the intersection operation of multiple sets is carried out, and the maximum frequent itemset is mined through a certain number of iterations. Compared with the traditional Apriori algorithm, the correctness and reliability of the mining results are verified. It shows that the MI_Apriori algorithm has better computational performance, and the improvement effect of the traditional Apriori algorithm is obvious.

articleTitle: Research on the effectiveness of educational incentive mechanism to promote college students' e-commerce Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This paper mainly adopts the methods of expert interview and questionnaire survey to collect and sort out the educational incentive policies and data of promoting college students' e-commerce entrepreneurship, and carries out statistical analysis through SPSS and Excel software. The analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model are used to analyze the relevant data. Through the analysis, it is found that the e-commerce entrepreneurship of college students is related to the government's entrepreneurship policy, the entrepreneurship education mechanism of colleges and universities, and the entrepreneurial environment of all sectors of society. Only by constantly improving the relevant policies and mechanisms of e-commerce entrepreneurship, can we make the e-commerce entrepreneurship education mechanism better serve college students, thus promoting the e-commerce entrepreneurship of college students.

articleTitle: The effect of self-construction on impulse buying: Based on the adjustment effect of discount uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The consumption concept of modern people is quite different. Compared with the past, they are more impulsive, more pursued and have a sense of enjoyment. Impulsive buying is a highly neuro-excited behavior that makes purchasing decisions in a short period of time. Consumers are highly nervous when acquiring items, but they may feel guilty and regret after consumption. This is a kind of behavior-unplanned before purchase, excitement during purchase, regret after purchase, this complex psychological change has aroused the research interest of many scholars at home and abroad. This dissertation takes self as the starting point for research and divides self-construction into four dimensions: group-self, self-expression, self-pleasure, self-realization, combined with emotional attachment, explores the formation mechanism of impulsive buying, in addition to study the moderating influence of discount uncertainty on impulsive buying behavior, and divide the moderating variable of discount uncertainty into three scenarios: scenario one is deterministic discount, scenario two is uncertainty discount, and scenario three is large scale Uncertainty discounts, trying to explain why people have the impulse to consume. The results of the study found that: the four constructs of self-construction are significantly positively correlated with emotional attachment; emotional attachment is significantly positively correlated with impulsive purchases; emotional attachment acts as a bridge between self-construction and impulsive purchases; the uncertainty of discounts has a moderating influence on the path from affective attachment to impulse buying.

articleTitle: The acyclic coloring of the Corona product and Edge corona product of special graphs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: An acyclic coloring of a graph is a proper vertex coloring such that there are no bichromatic cycles. The acyclic chromatic number of G, denoted a(G), is the minimum number of colors required for acyclic coloring of a graph G. We study the acyclic coloring of the corona product, edge corona product of paths or circles and any simple graph, and the corresponding acyclic chromatic number are determined.

articleTitle: Research History and Trend of Scientific Research Management : Big Data Analysis Based on Bibliometrix Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: This study uses Bibliometrix to analyze the results of 570 literature search on scientific research management from Web of Science, and uses text analysis technology to explore the research results in this field for more than 20 years and the evolution of the theme.

articleTitle: Design of Power Grid Data Asset Management System Based on Directory Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Grid enterprises started late in data management, development, and applications, due to the constraints of the industry, business structure and technical means. As an innovative application of both technical solutions and management means, blockchain is highly compatible with data asset management. This paper designs a directory blockchain system based on blockchain technology and power grid data resource directory, which records the source, use, sharing and other operations of power grid business data, so as to ensure that the ownership, location, content and other information cannot be tampered with. Three stages of application scenarios are designed to gradually expand the directory blockchain nodes and application scope from the inside to the outside, so as to upgrade the data governance level and promote open data sharing.

articleTitle: A Semi-Parametric Method to Estimate VaR with EVT and ES
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) is probably the most widely used risk measure in financial institutions, which is a quantile of the loss distribution in nature. In this article, a semi-parametric method which is based on the Extreme Value Theory(EVT) and the Historical Simulation(HS) is proposed to estimate VaR. We use EVT to estimate the tails and HS to simulate the interior. An empirical study using the daily returns of S&P 500 index is also presented. It's shown that that our approach is an adequate risk measure.

articleTitle: How to apply computer science and technology to enhance original innovation capability of Gansu manufacturing : Case study based on Huawei and Haier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: How to apply computer engineering technology and digital technology to improve Gansu's original innovation capability is of great significance to the high-quality development of regional economy. This paper takes Haier and Huawei as representative and typical enterprises, and extracts the basic experience and mechanism of computer technology application in China's leading manufacturing enterprises based on multi-case study method. On this basis, the strategy of computer technology to improve the original innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises in Gansu Province is designed in a targeted and forward-looking way: first, it should give play to the function of artificial intelligence strategic orientation. The concrete measures are to attach importance to strategic choice, construct competitive advantage through information technology strategy, and allocate resources by combining with computer information system. Second, it would gradually implement a Total Innovation Management mechanism by using computer technology, including a total factors synergy mechanism, time & space based innovation mechanism, all innovators mechanism and a comprehensive coordination mechanism. Third, it should foster and introduce innovative culture; Fourth, applying computer models to improve sustainable and innovative public policies, mainly by making good use of financial innovation funds and building an information ecosystem.

articleTitle: Design of encoding and decoding of Hamming code based on VHDL
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Hamming code is used for forward error correction, and the encoding decoding is to monitor and detect the information transmission by adding a certain supervisory code element after the information code element, and point out the location of the error code. The emergence of Hamming code decoding greatly reduces the cost of forward error correction, reduces the bit error rate of transmission, improves the ability of error correction, and improves the reliability and stability of the system. A VHDL - based coder and decoder is designed, which adopts Hamming code encoding and decoding, DPSK modulation and parallel string conversion module. The detailed software implementation method is given, and the simulation verification is carried out. The results show that the bit error rate of system transmission can be greatly reduced and the error correction ability of the system can be improved under the condition of high bit rate.

articleTitle: Design of printing enterprise warehouse management system based on Java
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In this paper combining with the characteristics of current printing enterprise warehouse, the use cases and business processes of warehouse management system are analyzed, and the functions of goods information, suppliers and warehouse management are realized by using Java programming language and Spring framework. By utilizing the cooperation of Web, the warehouse management system has characteristics of robust, simple, high scalability and ease of maintain and use.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technologies of Relation Extraction from Quality Text for Industrial Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Relation extraction of quality reports in industrial manufacturing industries such as automobiles and machinery is of great significance to the research of quality knowledge graph and quality question answering system of the industry. However, there is no available public dataset for relation extraction of quality reports, and there are few pieces of research on relation extraction of Chinese quality reports. For the above problems, this paper constructs a professional dataset for relation extraction and proposes a Chinese-based Piecewise Convolutional Neural Networks (C-PCNN) for the relation extraction of quality reports. To be more specific, this paper first collects quality reports in the field of industrial manufacturing and makes corresponding professional labels to construct a professional dataset. Then this paper learns a developed PCNN model based on Chinese characteristics by this constructed dataset, and finally this paper applies it to relation extraction in Chinese quality reports. Experimental results on the constructed dataset show that the accuracy, recall, and F1 values of the C-PCNN are 0.8234, 0.8076, 0.8154 respectively, better than PCNN and RNN, indicating the feasibility and effectiveness of the method. This research has practical significance for personnel engaged in the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Vegetable Supply Chain Management System Based on Spring MVC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the new economic situation and today with advanced information, people have higher requirements for enterprise resource planning (ERP). In today's Internet era, how companies use the Internet and other high-tech technologies to manage the vegetable supply chain has become an urgent problem to be solved, The system is based on web application software, uses advanced MVC architecture, adheres to the principles of horizontal resource management, multi-win and mutual benefit, cooperation and sharing, rapid response, synchronous operation, and dynamic reconfiguration, scientific management of all links in the supply chain, and scientific management of vege tables The whole process of making vegetable supply chain management (SCM) transparent and digital management.

articleTitle: Network Risk Assessment Based on Stochastic Forest Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the wide application of computer network, the problem of network security has become increasingly prominent. At present, for all the network protection measures, it is very difficult to protect the absolute security of the network. Therefore, this paper introduces the concept of network node relevance (NNC), and puts forward the classification method of NNC by analyzing several visiting scenarios in practice. The decision tree and random forest method are used to analyze the influence of relevant information on credit rating, and the network risk assessment based on random forest model is constructed. The experimental results show that the method can effectively evaluate the risk level of the network, and keep the inherent uncertainty in the evaluation process to the maximum extent. Compared with the traditional evaluation method based on fuzzy set theory, it has higher reliability and improves the scientificity and accuracy of the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Algorithm of glass cleaning robot on regular shaped glass
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency, large blind area, and the problem that glass size affects wiping efficiency and blind area, we propose a square wave wiping path, and propose a robot structure suitable for square wave path motion. The relationship between wiping efficiency and wiping blind area of Z-shaped path and boundary triangle path and the glass size and steering angle are analyzed in detail. The wiping efficiency and wiping blind area are contradictory under these two paths. In addition to the structure blind area caused by the robot's own structure, the wiping blind area of square wave path is 0, which is not affected by glass size. Set the size of the glass turning angle, in the ideal situation, compared the three ways of wiping blind area, wiping efficiency, square wave path wiping blind area is smaller than the others , and the square wave path reaches the ideal blind area level. The square wave path proposed in this paper can effectively solve the contradiction between wiping efficiency and wiping blind zone.

articleTitle: Research on power purchase recommendation Algorithm based on user collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: After the power purchasing and selling market is liberalized, the power purchasing party and the power selling party can realize power trading through bilateral negotiation. However, how big power users can find suitable trading objects from various electricity sellers is a subject to be studied. Centering on the problem of power purchase recommendation under the circumstance of information overload in the process of direct power purchase by large users, this paper studies the key technology of the recommendation algorithm, the recommendation algorithm based on user collaborative filtering and its application, etc., and verifies the rationality of the above algorithm after the analysis of calculation examples.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Performance Evaluation of Food Manufacturing Listed Companies Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: On the basis of understanding the existing relevant literature and theories, this paper uses 41 listed food manufacturing companies in China and selects 16 financial performance evaluation indicators, uses factor analysis to evaluate 16 financial indicators for the three years from 2014 to 2016. The analysis results show that the overall performance of listed companies in China's food manufacturing industry needs to be improved. Among the selected 41 companies, there are obvious differences in the performance of each company. Listed companies and various stakeholders should rationally look at the financial performance rankings, weigh the pros and cons of all aspects of the company, and make appropriate decisions.

articleTitle: An Improved Data Provenance Framework Integrating Blockchain and PROV Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Data tracing is an important topic in the era of digital economy when data are considered as one of the core factors in economic activities. However, the current data traceability systems often fail to obtain public trust due to their centralization and opaqueness. Blockchain possesses natural technical features such as data tampering resistance, anonymity, encryption security, etc., and shows great potential of improving the data tracing credibility. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-PROV-based multi-center data provenance solution in where the PROV model standardizes the data record storage and provenance on the blockchain automatically and intelligently. The solution improves the transparency and credibility of the provenance data, such as to help the efficient control and open sharing of data assets.

articleTitle: Certificateless Aggregate Signature schemes for Privacy Protection of Security Anlysis and Improvement
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) is an open environment. In VANET, it needs protect some privacy information of the vehicle, such as the real identity of the vehicle, the number of the vehicle. Certificateless aggregate signature (CLAS) scheme can reduce the calculation cost and communication cost due to the aggregation property, which is important part of cryptography. In this paper, we present two CLAS schemes proposed recently and also give a security analysis on the two CLAS schemes. By security analysis on the both CLAS schemes, it finds that the two CLAS schemes can be forged by the malicious enemy by replacing the public key of the user but without knowing the master key of key generation center. At the same time, we also show that second CLAS scheme does not satisfy the tractability property. In other words, the malicious vehicle cannot be traced after it makes some malicious signatures. We also present an improved CLAS schemes based on the original CLAS scheme respectively. By some security analysis and efficiency analysis, it can find that the improved CLAS schemes both not only can overcome the security problem but also are still efficient.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Executive Compensation in Chinese enterprises in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The Internet + ideological trend has become one of the important technical supports for the transformation and upgrading of all industries, thus "Internet + tax" emerges at the historic moment, and big data analysis is an important component of this new tax work mode. The arrival of the era of big data has brought great changes to human resource management, especially to the problem of executive compensation tax avoidance. This paper combines the current Internet + tax in China and draws on the experience of the new personal income tax reform in the United States to reshape the design and management of corporate executive compensation.

articleTitle: The Bias-variance Decomposition in Profiled Attacks Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Side channel analysis/attack(SCA) is one of the main security threats to cryptographic devices. The attacker analyzes the leaked information during the physical realization of the cryptographic algorithm, and then recovers the key information. This poses a serious threat to the security of cryptographic algorithms. In recent years, with the continuous development of deep learning technology, profiled side-channel attacks based on deep learning technology pose severe challenges to the security of encryption devices. For bias-variance decomposition is an effective tool for evaluating the prediction errors of deep neural network models, this paper proposes a deep learning model evaluation method based on bias-variance decomposition, witch divides the performance of side-channel attack models based on deep neural network into four levels. This paper analyzes the performance of the deep neural network model used for side-channel attacks through experiments, and then realizes parameter optimization and model performance evaluation, so as to better evaluate the performance of the deep neural network model used for side-channel attacks.

articleTitle: A Method of Network Topology Discovery Based on Knowledge Reasoning : Based on more than heterogeneous data sources
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: At present, the network has gradually become the foundation of information construction. People have more demands for network topology management. The increasing scale of network topology and the heterogeneity between devices and protocols have brought great difficulties to network topology discovery. This paper proposes a knowledge-based reasoning Network topology discovery method. This method uses multiple heterogeneous data sources, uses computer network prior knowledge to construct a knowledge base from top to bottom, uses inference learning to establish reasoning rules, and then constructs a multi-level network topology structure.

articleTitle: Research for the Synergy Information Flow Structure Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of joint operations, the synergy information flow structure (SIFS) has become more and more complex. By extracting the characteristics of different combat periods, we construct 6 different topological structures, namely, without coordination group in the service, with target guidance (instruction) group in the service, with data links in the service and without targeted coordination groups between services, with data links in the service and targeted coordination groups between the services, with data links in and between the services. By using complex network statistical indicators, network efficiency coefficients (CNE) and network synchronization indicators, we analyze the invulnerability and synchronization of different synergy information flow structures, and make useful explorations for the design and optimization for SIFS.

articleTitle: Research on Real Time E-Commerce Optimiazation Strategy of Power Enterprise Marketing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the improvement of new energy application technology, the space of time difference of traditional electric energy has been further reduced. The dynamics of the market environment are changing, and power companies need to improve their ability to respond quickly and flexibly, and actively respond to changes in the new environment. In this paper, a real time e-commerce optimization strategy and the implementation of power supply marketing innovation by power companies are proposed through e-commerce platforms and proposes specific strategies. We design this strategy by proposing and improving real time power marketing concepts and optimal mechanisms, the results show that the proposed strategy can strengthen the capacity of user data management, enhancing service levels and finally broadening service channels.

articleTitle: Research on the application of SAP system to information management of private colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the guidance of the principles and methods of management information system, enterprise information management and other theories, this paper analyzes the current situation of private colleges and universities in their own information construction, finds out the main problems in promoting their own information construction, and analyzes the causes of the problems, and then puts forward targeted improvement strategies to promote their own information management construction To speed up the systematic construction.

articleTitle: The Evolution of China’s Tax Reform under the influence of "Internet + Tax" -- Take executive Compensation as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Under the background of Internet economy, big data will become the main melody of the new round of Internet development. The era of big data has come with the development of e-government, such as Internet + tax, Golden Tax Phase III and value-added tax electronic invoice system. The economic activities and business modes characterized by big data show complexity and diversity, which has an impact on China’s traditional tax management mode. By classifying and sorting out relevant documents of Tax reform in China and the United States under the background of existing big data, the tax reform will have a significant impact and change on executive compensation.

articleTitle: Scale-free analysis of scientific collaboration hyper- networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Analysis of the scale free characteristics of scientific collaboration hyper-network can help us understand the characteristics of complex networks in the real world and conduct further research. Establishing a general hyper-network model is an effective method to study the real network characteristics and explore the main conditions for generating various characteristics. In this paper, several groups of experiments are carried out to verify the scale-free formation mechanism of the hyper-network and the simulation results of the hyper degree distribution are verified by the mean field theory. Finally, taking the Acta Physica Sinica as an example, this paper constructs a scientific collaboration hyper-network based on the author's paper, and obtains the hyper-degree distribution results of the real network, which are in good agreement with the simulation results. The results show that the universal hyper- network model can fit the real network well, which indicates that the scientific collaboration hyper-network has scale-free characteristics

articleTitle: Design of a multi-scale query platform for China's PM2.5 Concentration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid economic development and the acceleration of urbanization, increase the Concentration of PM2.5, leading to a continuous decline in China's air quality. PM2.5 will cause a series of social problems such as damage to human health, reduced visibility, environmental pollution, and hidden traffic hazards. Many researchers are committed to PM2.5 pollution research, effective and reliable PM2.5 historical data is the basis of these studies. This research will design and develop a data query Visualization platform that provides national monthly, quarterly, and annual average PM2.5 Concentrations. The platform can provide researchers with effective, reliable, and processed data for free, which will greatly reduce the time cost of data processing in the early stage of the experiment and shorten the research cycle.

articleTitle: The Independent set polynomials of a class of crown product
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
