articleTitle: A Ticket-Based Anonymous Authentication Protocol for Mobile Roaming Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Ticket based anonymous authentication protocol is an important branch of anonymous authentication protocol research. In this paper, we propose an anonymous authentication protocol for large-scale practical applications, which satisfies that the interaction rounds are few and the efficiency is high. Analysis shows that the ticket can be used multiple times, the ticket generation phase does not need the participation of the foreign network server, and the roaming authentication phase does not need the participation of the home network server.

articleTitle: Research on Robustness Simulation of Interdependent Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the deepening of complex network research, related theoretical methods have become more mature, and the study of interdependent networks has gradually attracted people's attention. Studying the robustness of interdependent networks is of great significance for the establishment of real-world network models. The generation mechanism of the interdependent network model is analyzed. Combining with the research of the dependent network theory, starting from a single network cascading failure form, a giant component-based dependent network cascade failure model is established. Network robustness of BA-BA, WS-WS, and ER-ER are studied in attack and combination attack modes. The results show that the BA-BA interdependent network has the highest robustness under random failure modes, the ER-ER interdependent network has the highest robustness under random failure modes, and the network robustness under combined failure modes is determined by the main failure modes. The conclusions obtained in this paper can provide reference for subsequent research on cascading faults in interdependent networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of price correlation of two kinds of graded funds
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the growth of economy and the improvement of per capita income, investment activities have attracted more and more attention. As an investment tool, classified funds have also been developing continuously. Because its sub funds have different returns and risks, which can meet the different needs of investors, it is very important to strengthen investors' understanding of graded funds. This paper takes all existing classified funds in China as the object of empirical test, from January 1, 2016 to December 1,2016, to analyze the correlation between class Ashare price and class B share price. The empirical test results show that the price of class A shares and class B shares is low correlation. Therefore, when the price of class A shares goes up or down, investors cannot infer whether the price of class B shares will rise or fall according to the price changes of class A shares, so as to obtain more profits.

articleTitle: Porting and Optimizing G-BLASTN to the ROCm-based Supercomputer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: ROCm, the complete GPGPU ecosystem launched by AMD in 2015, is the first open-source software development platform for HPC/Hyperscale-class GPU computing and corresponds to NIVIDIA's CUDA platform. G-BLASTN widely used and indispensable in the field of bioinformatics which is an accelerated nucleotide comparison tool based on NCBI-BLAST. However, G-BLASTN is designed to run on CUDA platform which cannot run on ROCm. Given the popularity of ROCm and the importance of G-BLASTN, it's extremely important to porting and optimizing G-BLASTN on ROCm. This paper presented a new method of porting and optimization of G-BLASTN on ROCm-based supercomputers. First, this paper ported G-BLASTN to ROCm-based supercomputers. Based on the characteristics of the supercomputer's hardware configuration and the idea of offset collection of inductive nucleic acid sequences, this article proposed and implemented a new subject sequences H2D(host to device) transfer mode to replace the original time-consuming and inefficient transfer mode. In addition, according to the different warp specified by the two platforms, this paper adjusted the block size of the three HIP kernel functions when they were released during the word search phase. The experimental results show that performance of the optimized H2D transfer mode improves 23.6 times, and the performance of the three kernel functions improves 7.36 times, 3.02 times and 6.03 times respectively. The total performance improves 1.26 times.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Big Data Analysis in Different Levels of Tennis Players' Serve
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Objective: To explore the differences between different levels of tennis players' strong serve technique. Methods: By means of Qualisys, Kistler and High-speed photography, the relevant data of serving technical movements of two male professional tennis players and ten amateur tennis players in China were analyzed by using big data. Results: In the throwing stage, the maximum flexion angles of both knee joints of professional athletes were significantly smaller than that of amateur athletes (p<; 0.05, p<; 0.05). In the stage of pushing and turning, the maximum angular velocity of knee joint of the tested professional athletes was significantly higher than that of amateur athletes (p<; 0.05, p<; 0.05), and the maximum ground reaction force recorded in Z axis was significantly higher than that of amateur athletes (p<; 0.05). During the service process, the maximum external rotation angle of the upper arm of the professional athletes was significantly greater than that of the amateur athletes (p<; 0.05); the maximum shoulder and trunk torsion angles were significantly greater than those of the amateur athletes (p<; 0.05, p<; 0.05); the knee joint angle was significantly smaller than that of the amateur athletes (p<; 0.05). In the stage of swing, the maximum angular velocity of hip rotation, shoulder rotation, elbow extension, forearm internal rotation and racquet-head speed were significantly higher than those of amateur athletes (p<; 0.05, p<; 0.05, p<; 0.05, p<; 0.01, p<; 0.01); the impacting point height recorded was significantly higher than that of amateur players (p<; 0.05) The ball speed was significantly higher than that of amateur players (p<; 0.01). There was no significant difference in the other serve technical movement mechanics indexes. Conclusion: The main differences between different levels of tennis players are the range and speed of lower limb push, the amplitude and speed of trunk rotation, the rotation speed of hitting arm, the speed of racquet-head and the height of impacting point.

articleTitle: General Design of Automated Test System Software for Radar
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: According to the demands of open, universality and modularity criterion in radar equipment Automatic Test System (ATS), we developed universal radar ATS software system, this software system is consisted of system build-up module, sequence generation, calibration module, auto test module and Subsequent processing module. This software can used to do performances testing for some model radar. This software system has been applied in a certain new automatic test system for general radar.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Automatic Elastic Extension Architecture for Power Flow Calculation in Power System Based on Spring Cloud
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and cloud computing, people rely more and more on data information services. The disadvantages of the unified single architecture software system are becoming increasingly prominent, which severely restricts the rapid upgrade and delivery of soft-ware. Traditional software gradually has problems such as low computational performance and limited algorithm scalability. Power flow calculation in power system is one of the important methods to analyze power quality. This method has the characteristics of large amount of data and large amount of calculation. The traditional calculation method is increasingly difficult to meet its calculation requirements. Based on the micro-service architecture implemented by Spring Cloud framework, this paper analyzes the automatic adjustment of power flow calculation in power system. In the process of adjustment, the mathematical model of power flow calculation should be established first, and the guiding principles of optimal selection of adjustment targets and control variables are given. Case studies show that the method fully considers the interaction and influence between various targets and control variables, effectively ensures the development of the adjustment scheme to-wards target improvement, and achieves better adjustment effect.

articleTitle: Construction and Evaluation of Business Environment Index System under Internet environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: In the information age, cloud computing provides unlimited possibilities for enterprise innovation products. Big data has changed the operation mode of enterprises, smart mobile devices have changed the way enterprises operate, and the Internet has changed the means of dissemination of enterprise information, as well as the public and enterprises. Relations and ways of getting along with government agencies. The business environment has an important influence on the innovation and entrepreneurial vitality of enterprises in a region. The improvement of the business environment will directly affect the production, sales and operation of local enterprises from the micro level, and determine the success or failure of investment promotion; the macro level is an important support for promoting regional economic development. Effective communication, cooperation, and participation in market competition are conducive to improvement. Regional competitiveness and economic soft power. In order to create a good business environment and carry out business environment assessment with Chinese characteristics, each region uses big data, cloud computing and intelligent technology to evaluate the business environment of each region, and establish a corresponding indicator system. Based on the "2017-2018 Report on the Business Environment of Major Cities in China", this article compares and analyzes the domestic and foreign business environment index evaluation systems in the Internet environment, and promotes the improvement of the corporate environment and the optimization of the political-business relationship for computer information technology and Internet technology Provide theoretical basis and practical support.een the business environment and regional economic development.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Scalability of State Grid chain-Data Side chain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Blockchain is a global research hotspot with the technical characteristics of building trust at low costs in open networks. However, the blockchain scalability problem has become the bottleneck of further application development, with the fast and widely spreading applications. This paper first analyzes the endogenous reasons that restrict the performance improvement of blockchain, and then summarizes the technology principles of three-layer blockchain scalability proposed by the current academia and enterprises, and makes a comparative analysis on the scalability effect, technical difficulty and practical application. Finally, we propose a distributed autonomous management solution for area partition and business channel, which guides an easy and executable scalability route for the State Grid chain-data side chain (SG-DSC).

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Resource Values Based on Citespace Network Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Based on the value-added process, resources in the network platform economic environment are preliminarily divided into content resources, service resources, technical resources, and data resources. Based on the CNKI database, this article uses the data visualization software CiteSpace to visually compare and analyze the author cooperation, agency cooperation, and hot topics of the four types of resource value. In addition, a deep-level comparative analysis of the research status of the four types of resource values is made in three aspects: value evaluation methods, research fields, and value connotations. Through research, it is found that the four types of resources add value to resources in a cross-wise manner, and finally form a complex heterogeneous resource body of multiple value types.

articleTitle: Using knowledge Graphs to Enhance the Interpretability of Clinical Decision Support Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Current clinical practice relies heavily on technology to support decision-making. In particular, machine learning is increasingly used in decision support systems. This can be attributed to information overload, a fact that clinicians cannot consider all available information. The disadvantage of this method is that this kind of Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSSs) is usually a black box, and it can’t understand its decision-making reasons. However, in a healthcare environment, trust and accountability are important issues, and such systems should best be interpretable. In contrast, other areas rely almost entirely on observational or subjective patient reported questionnaires to quantify medical conditions. Developers need to use cognitive science based Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) research methods to design practice models, including user-centered iterative design and common standards. The main work of this paper is to propose a clinical decision support model with enhanced interpretability, including an automated interface generation engine. In the design of personalized decision-making, enhance the universality of decision-making push. The clinical evidence is input and displayed in the form of tables, and the medical concepts and their matching with SNOMED CT terms, consistent navigation, and finally displayed in the form of knowledge spectrum. Enhance the flexibility of interaction and integrate workflow seamlessly. As a result, domain experts can get advice quickly and take appropriate actions at convenient points in the workflow without additional effort or delay. Optimizing the interaction and availability of CDSS with providers can enhance the use of CDSS. The iterative design of CDSS improves the usability of the system and the user’s popularity score. Our analysis shows that modern machine learning methods can provide interpretability compatible with domain Interpretation Knowledge Base (IKB) and traditional method ranking. Future work should focus on replicating these findings in other datasets and further testing different interpretable methods.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation model of subject competition based on the "four in one" practical innovation ability training mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: The emergence of new engineering has promoted the development of computer discipline competition. Undergraduate professional evaluation can effectively diagnose the quality level of colleges and universities. Discipline competition is an important link in the professional training system of undergraduate colleges and universities. Based on the "four in one" practical innovation ability training mode, this paper designs the evaluation model of discipline competition and constructs a systematic evaluation index system of discipline competition Department, to provide reference for professional evaluation and discipline competition in undergraduate colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Application of Accounting Information System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: As a product of a new generation of technological innovation, Blockchain technology has been widely used in finance, supply chain, public services, and other fields due to its advantages of tamper-proof, timestamp, and irreversibility. With the continuous development of its technology and the accumulation of integration experience with various industries, the application of blockchain technology to the accounting industry in the transformation from man-machine cooperation mode to intelligent mode, and the realization of the integration of blockchain technology and accounting information system are urgent problems to be solved in the accounting field at home and abroad. Based on the characteristics of the integration of blockchain technology and accounting information system, the virtual currency payment, blockchain electronic invoice, hash value, and hash reference are introduced into accounting information processing flow. Based on the significance analysis of the integration of blockchain technology and accounting information system, it is proposed to construct from the aspects of virtual currency payment, a traceable data processing platform, decentralized storage platform, user credit evaluation, and others, and to carry out heuristic thinking from the aspects of setting up a research and development team of "blockchain + accounting information system," unifying laws and regulations of "blockchain + accounting information system" in various countries, and changing the concept of accounting practitioners.

articleTitle: Research on the New Era Artificial Intelligence Promoting the Reform of College English Ecological Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Science and Management Technology (ICCSMT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is the result of the in-depth development of a new round of technology and industrial revolution, and is of great significance to promoting the overall progress of society. Artificial intelligence has also brought new development opportunities and challenges to college English teaching. Based on the changes in the college English ecological teaching model under the background of artificial intelligence, this paper analyzes what is ecological linguistics and what is college English ecological teaching. On this basis, it analyzes the current college English teaching ecology in my country, and proposes artificial Suggestions for smart promotion of college English ecological teaching reform.
